scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The proposed KCNK9/TASK-3-to-resting K+ conductance-to-input resistance mechanism is well established and biologically coherent. The main uncertainty is the strength and specificity of Kcnk9 enrichment in adult visual-cortex PV interneurons.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: KCNK9 abundance, membrane TASK-3 channels, resting potassium conductance, the PV fast-spiking state, and input resistance are connected through an explicit causal chain. The PV state is used mainly to identify the predicted Kcnk9-high context rather than being mechanistically linked to Kcnk9 regulation. No synthesis ceiling was applied because the principal channel-to-conductance-to-resistance transitions are explicit and biologically defensible.
